facts.fact: AMECC Comores states that the study on digitalisation of the civil registration system was launched at a workshop on 2 October 2025, which validated the methodology and roadmap and set up shared governance, with working groups continuing afterwards.
facts.system: AMECC (étude sur la digitalisation du système d'état civil)
